issues.title: Requires "ISUI/ISWorldMap", which Build 42 moved
issues.note: The game answers with "module not found" or an attempted index of a nil value when the file loads. Build 42 has the module at "ISUI/Maps/ISWorldMap".
issues.source: PZ Mod Studio, verified in the game's console.txt on 42.21 (2026-10-18)

issues.title: Formatting "Sandbox_Reac..." warns in the log
issues.note: A WARN from Translator.reportMissingArgumentsFromPastAbuse about a sandbox option's text with a stray format sign. The game carries on; nothing to fix on the player's side.
issues.source: PZ Mod Studio, verified in the game's console.txt on 42.21 (2026-10-18)
